content: navigator.vibrate() is NOT supported on iOS Safari (any version, confirmed as of 2026 — one unverified GitHub report claims partial support but is unconfirmed/contradicts MDN and caniuse) and is not supported on desktop Safari (macOS) at all. It IS supported on Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Samsung Internet on Android. Any haptic call must be optional/best-effort (wrapped in try/catch, feature-detected with navigator.vibrate?.()) since a large fraction of mobile users (all iOS Safari) will silently no-op.
